title: 오랜만에 만났어요: 요즘 뭐 하고 있어요?
objective: Greet someone you have not seen for a while and say what you are doing with -고 있어요.
summary: Two acquaintances meet again and talk about what they are doing these days.
setting: Minsu and Sarah used to know each other. They meet by chance in front of a café after a long time.

task.title: Catch up in Korean
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to complete each item; for -고 있어요, add 고 있어요 to the verb stem.

words.exampleMeaning: Teacher, it's been a long time!

words.meaning: What about ...? (는요 after a vowel, 은요 after a consonant)
words.exampleMeaning: I drink coffee. What about your younger sibling?
The weather is cold these days.

words.meaning: am/is doing; verb stem + 고 있어요
words.exampleMeaning: I'm waiting for the bus now.

words.meaning: to go to (a school or workplace) regularly
words.exampleMeaning: My younger sibling goes to university.

words.meaning: to learn, to take lessons in
words.exampleMeaning: I take taekwondo lessons on weekends.

dialogue.meaning: Oh, Sarah! Long time no see.

dialogue.korean: 민수 씨, 정말 오랜만이에요! 잘 지냈어요?
dialogue.meaning: Minsu, it's really been a long time! Have you been well?
Yes, I've been well. What about you, Sarah?

dialogue.korean: 저도 잘 지냈어요. 그런데 요즘 좀 바빠요.
dialogue.meaning: I've been well too. But I'm a bit busy these days.
Really? What are you doing these days?

dialogue.korean: 한국어 학원에 다니고 있어요. 민수 씨는요?
dialogue.meaning: I'm going to a Korean language school. How about you?
These days I'm learning to cook.

exercises: Choose the best first line: You meet a friend you have not seen for six months. (a) 감사합니다 (b) 오랜만이에요 (c) 안녕히 계세요
Fill in the blank to ask the same question back: A: 잘 지냈어요? B: 네, 잘 지냈어요. 선생님____?
Fill in the blank with -고 있어요 (듣다): 저는 지금 음악을 ____.
Change each sentence to the -고 있어요 form: ① 형은 은행에서 일해요. ② 저는 요즘 중국어를 공부해요.
Answer in Korean: Your friend asks 「요즘 뭐 하고 있어요?」 Say you are working at a café.
answers: ① 형은 은행에서 일하고 있어요. ② 저는 요즘 중국어를 공부하고 있어요.
카페에서 일하고 있어요. (요즘 카페에서 일하고 있어요. / 저는 카페에서 일하고 있어요.)
